_comment: Artifex's source layout, for Tasktracker's architecture-drift walker. Without this the walker falls back to its built-in defaults, which are NestJS/Angular filename suffixes plus that project's own directory prefixes — on this monorepo they inventoried 7 of ~142 source files, so honest component references were reported as `orphaned` (friction 7ef7a267). Everything Artifex ships lives under packages/ or tools/, named for what it does rather than for a framework convention.
_scope: packages/ only. `tools/` is the AI-layer dev tooling (the codebase-search MCP), not the product ARCHITECTURE.md describes — the same line the walker's own defaults draw when they ignore tests. Build and test scaffolding is excluded for that reason too, not to flatter the count.
